verdict.rationale: Gemini has a dedicated rate-limits docs page ('View your active rate limits in AI Studio'), and its pricing docs say paid tiers get higher rate limits for production. A community report corroborates a tier structure with daily request caps and spend-based tier qualification. The pack does not show per-model RPM/TPM figures, the exact tier scaling rules, or what a 429 response looks like. missing for 10: documented requests/tokens-per-minute tables, explicit tier-scaling criteria in first-party docs, 429 error format and retry guidance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits — requests and tokens per unit time, how tiers scale, and what a 429 looks like — before I hit them in production
